### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **292** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**63** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1aeeafd9d371be1fd5afa637c4f0ae6b6f4c1404`.

⛔ **19** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (symbol, 49 pages)`
- **33** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **222** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **159** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **159**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **2** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1aeeafd9d371be1fd5afa637c4f0ae6b6f4c1404` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `207fb4b941de851f9d772488aacfb4b531f4b128` — the merge of head `d104e2b4247de8c39d84c79ab7bcccd7abd220a4` into base `1aeeafd9d371be1fd5afa637c4f0ae6b6f4c1404`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 207fb4b941de851f9d772488aacfb4b531f4b128 && git checkout 207fb4b941de851f9d772488aacfb4b531f4b128
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 1aeeafd9d371be1fd5afa637c4f0ae6b6f4c1404 d104e2b4247de8c39d84c79ab7bcccd7abd220a4 && git checkout -B drift-repro 1aeeafd9d371be1fd5afa637c4f0ae6b6f4c1404 && git merge --no-ff d104e2b4247de8c39d84c79ab7bcccd7abd220a4

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1aeeafd9d371be1fd5afa637c4f0ae6b6f4c1404
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 1aeeafd9d371be1fd5afa637c4f0ae6b6f4c1404` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e8d9055ec7ca343cb5b308a8019843f5c138f7e7`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/{zh-Hant.ts, zh-Hant.source-hashes.ts, zh-Hant.objects.generated.ts, zh-Hant.metadata-forms.generated.ts, zh-Hant.source-hashes.generated.ts, setup.translation.ts, index.ts}, packages/platform-objects/src/metadata-translations/index.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/pages/{sys-user,sys-organization}.page.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/dashboards/system.datasets.ts, packages/cli/test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts, the 19 platform-objects test files, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/people-org-assignment-nav-contribution.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/translations/approval-status-vocabulary.test.ts, packages/services/service-settings/src/setup-nav-hub-parity.test.ts, .changeset/30512-platform-objects-locales-zh-hant.md + packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/{en,zh-CN,es-ES}.ts, {en,zh-CN}.objects.generated.ts, {en,zh-CN}.metadata-forms.generated.ts, {zh-CN,es-ES}.source-hashes*.ts, source-hash.ts, packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/zh-Hant.ts (main), packages/plugins/{plugin-approvals,plugin-sharing}/src/translations/zh-Hant.objects.generated.ts (main), packages/services/service-messaging/src/translations/zh-Hant.objects.generated.ts (main), scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs, root package.json, card #30512 and its comments, dev report 6686432570, PR #30951 body, precedent PRs #30870 and #30931

Diff read against merge base `33043bd8a2b34ed2efdc188f38173c1c44ca3f36`: one commit, 36 files, +7216/-55. The head did not move during the review.

### ① Derived judgments

**Must-fix:** none.

**Should-fix:** none that blocks. Two wording notes, both inherited from `zh-CN` and so not a defect of this PR:
- `帳戶` (4 uses: the Account app label, `nav_account_linked`, the Linked Accounts tab, two action dialogs) beside `帳號` (13 uses) for "account". `zh-CN` makes the same split (账户 / 账号). A later pass could pick one.
- The user page's two-factor card says `兩步驟驗證` (`sys-user.page.ts:482`) while the `sys_user` object copy says `雙因素驗證` (13 leaves). Again a mirror of `zh-CN` (两步验证 vs 双因素).

**Confirmed, by file.**

Generated bundles (the shape question):
- `zh-Hant.objects.generated.ts` is 3810 lines, `zh-Hant.metadata-forms.generated.ts` 2815, `zh-Hant.source-hashes.generated.ts` 61: line-for-line the same length as the `zh-CN` and `en` files, same header text, same export shape (`zhHantObjects: NonNullable<TranslationData['objects']>` at line 17, `zhHantMetadataForms` likewise, `zhHantGeneratedSourceHashes: Readonly<Record<string, string>>` at line 20).
- Key sets counted programmatically: 2937 string leaves in `en`, `zh-CN` and `zh-Hant` each (1674 `objects` + 1263 `metadataForms`), key order identical to `en`, 0 missing, 0 extra. The PR body's counts (1,674 / 1,263) are right.
- Source hashes: `zh-Hant.source-hashes.generated.ts` has 40 entries, the same 40 paths as `zh-CN`'s table. Every one of the 40 digests equals `hashSource(en leaf)` recomputed with the function at `source-hash.ts:270`, and every one of those 40 `zh-Hant` leaves is a byte copy of `en` (ID, JWKS, Client ID, the SSO placeholders). Exactly 40 `zh-Hant` leaves equal `en`, all 40 carry an entry, and 0 leaves are English where `zh-CN` translates. So "40 echoes, the same 40 zh-CN decided" holds.
- Hand bundle `zh-Hant.ts`: 138 leaves, same key set as `en.ts`, `zh-CN.ts` and `es-ES.ts` (138 each), key order equal to `zh-CN.ts` (the hand files already differ from `en.ts` in order; not new). `zh-Hant.source-hashes.ts`: 138 entries, one per leaf, 0 mismatches against the current `en.ts` source, 0 entries for unknown paths. That is more complete than `zh-CN`'s 131; fine. Three hand leaves equal `en` on purpose: `nav_webhooks` = `Webhooks` (comment at `zh-Hant.ts:105-109` records why), `apps.studio.label` = `Studio`, `group_ai` = `AI`.
- Input change: `scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` adds `zh-Hant` to the docstring `--locales` (line 11, what `check-i18n-bundles.mjs` executes, see its line 37), imports the two generated bundles and the hand bundle (lines 224, 229, 252) and adds the `zh-Hant` merge-baseline row (line 353). Nothing else in the config moved. The root `package.json` `i18n:extract` script (line 29) still lists three locales; the dev records this as left for the series' last PR. It does not affect the gate.

Translation quality (about 30 leaves read by hand across `sys_user`, `sys_organization`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_api_key`, `sys_oauth_*`, `sys_scim_*`, `sys_email_template`, `sys_import_job`, `sys_setting_audit`, the `object`, `field`, `view`, `page`, `dashboard`, `action`, `dataset`, `permission` and `skill` forms, the Setup/Studio/Account nav, the dashboard widgets and the two record pages):
- Terms are the Taiwan register the nine earlier `zh-Hant` bundles use: 使用者, 電子郵件, 金鑰, 權杖, 工作階段, 稽核, 物件, 欄位, 檢視, 中繼資料, 套件, 範本, 唯讀, 字元, 圖示, 對話方塊, 「」quotes. Not a Simplified-to-Traditional character swap: e.g. "User" 用户 -> 使用者, "Session" 会话 -> 工作階段, "Icon" 图标 -> 圖示, "Readonly" 只读 -> 唯讀, "OAuth Apps" OAuth 应用 -> OAuth 應用程式.
- Simplified-only forms: a scan over all 2937 generated leaves, the 138 hand leaves and the 45 `zh-Hant` entries added to the pages and dataset finds 0 hits for 们 设 应 户 选 删 编 辑 规 则 类 价 审 务 组 织 关 联 数 据 报 网 页 视 图 导 认 证 码 线 级 别 录 时 间 为 这 会 说 将 与 当 办 对 开 发 现 实 际 议 记 转 达 该 项 东 车 门 问 题 让 产 义 无 经.
- 232 generated leaves are byte-equal to `zh-CN`; sampled, they are strings with no Simplified-only character (全部, 完成, 角色, 排序, 品牌, 已取消, 提供方 ID), so an unconverted leaf is not what they are.
- Placeholders and tokens (`{{ }}`, `{ }`, backtick spans, angle tokens) compared against `zh-CN`: 2 differences, both intended Chinese prose inside a token (`default:'該成員'` in `sys_member.update_member_role.description`; the JSON example `"已封存"` in `action.fields.outcomeMessages.helpText`). Against `en` there are 13 differences, and every one of them is already present in `zh-CN` (reordered backtick spans, a dropped or added code span in a help text); they are inherited, not introduced.
- The stale-fill fix: `metadataForms.action.fields.method.helpText` is `GET / POST / PUT / DELETE` in `zh-CN` and `HTTP 方法（GET、POST、PUT、DELETE）` in `zh-Hant` (`zh-Hant.metadata-forms.generated.ts`). `zh-CN` is untouched in the diff; `scripts/i18n-stale-fill-baseline.json` is not in the file list, so the baseline is untouched as claimed.

Non-bundle source edits, each only adds a `'zh-Hant'` key:
- `src/pages/sys-user.page.ts` (+35/-23): 23 one-line inline maps gain `'zh-Hant'` in place; 12 multi-line maps gain one `'zh-Hant':` line. No page, tab, section, field list, `visibleWhen` or action changed. The -23 are the rewritten single-line maps.
- `src/pages/sys-organization.page.ts` (+6/-6): the Members, Invitations and Teams tab labels and related-list titles gain `'zh-Hant'`.
- `src/apps/dashboards/system.datasets.ts:60`: `SysAuditLogDataset`'s `user_id` `nullLabel` gains `'zh-Hant': '系統'`.
- `src/apps/translations/setup.translation.ts`: three imports and the `'zh-Hant': withSourceFallback(zhHant, en, zhHantSourceHashes, zhHantGeneratedSourceHashes)` row (line 75), the same four-argument shape as the three rows above it; docstring updated.
- `src/apps/translations/index.ts:12`: `export { zhHant }`.
- `src/metadata-translations/index.ts`: two imports and the `'zh-Hant'` row (line 48) with the third argument `undefined`, as the other three; two docstring lines reworded from "three" to "the translated locales".

Deviations:
- `packages/cli/test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts:746`: `LOCALE_KEY` widens from `/^[a-z]{2}(-[A-Z]{2})?$/` to `/^[a-z]{2}(-[A-Z][a-z]{3})?(-[A-Z]{2})?$/`. The new pattern accepts a superset: every key the old one accepted is still accepted, and the only additions are `xx-Abcd` and `xx-Abcd-YY`. `isInlineLocaleMap` (line 749) requires every key to match, so under the old pattern a map holding `zh-Hant` was invisible and the floor at line 851 (`maps.length >= 38`) went red at 0, exactly as the dev reports. The test still catches what it caught: a non-locale key still makes a value not-a-map, the floor and the per-locale completeness check at lines 851-855 are unchanged, and with the widening all 45 inline maps on the two pages are judged in all five shipped locales.
- Tests that pin the shipped set: `plugin.translations.test.ts:195` (the ten-load list gains `'zh-Hant', 'zh-Hant'`), `setup-nav-per-user-stores.test.ts:116` (the sorted key list gains `'zh-Hant'`), `sys-user-details-tab.test.ts:37-47` (the three section fixtures gain the key), `system-overview-null-label.test.ts:33`, `people-org-assignment-nav-contribution.test.ts:183`. Each is the same assertion with one more element. The 15 list-iterating tests add `zh-Hant` to a `LOCALES` / `TRANSLATED` / `FORM_BUNDLES` constant and nothing else; `bu-rename-consistency.test.ts:24` holds `zh-Hant` to `/部門/` like `ja-JP`. No expectation was loosened anywhere in the 24 test files.

Cross-package pins, read in the merged `zh-Hant` bundles on `main`:
- `nav_account_approvals` = `待我核准` (`zh-Hant.ts:21`) = plugin-approvals `sys_approval_request._views.my_pending.label` (`plugin-approvals/.../zh-Hant.objects.generated.ts:123`). `approval-status-vocabulary.test.ts:143` now asserts it.
- `nav_assignment_rules` = `指派規則` (`zh-Hant.ts:66`) = plugin-sharing `sys_assignment_rule.label` (#30856, `plugin-sharing/.../zh-Hant.objects.generated.ts:348`).
- `nav_queues` = `佇列`, `nav_sharing_rules` = `共用規則`, `nav_approval_delegations` = `核准委派（外出）`, `nav_http_deliveries` = `HTTP 傳送`: each equals its object's `zh-Hant` label (`sys_queue:295`, `sys_sharing_rule:107`, `sys_approval_delegation:344` in plugin-approvals, `sys_http_delivery:319` in service-messaging). `nav_sso_providers` = `SSO 提供方` = `sys_sso_provider.pluralLabel` (`zh-Hant.objects.generated.ts:2016`).
- `nav_settings_*` (`zh-Hant.ts:89-100`) versus the #30870 hub titles in `service-settings/src/translations/zh-Hant.ts`: localization 在地化 (:123), company 公司 (:95), mail 郵件投遞 (:15), sms 簡訊投遞 (:48), branding 品牌 (:79), auth 驗證 (:195), storage 檔案儲存 (:284), ai AI 與 Embedder (:316), knowledge 知識庫 (:430), lifecycle 資料生命週期 (:466). All ten equal. `setup-nav-hub-parity.test.ts:49` now runs that comparison for `zh-Hant`.

Precedent: the shape matches #30870 and #30931 (one changeset, hand bundle per locale, registration row, coverage test widened) and the earlier generated-bundle packages (generated bundle + provenance companion + docstring `--locales` + merge-baseline row).

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/30512-platform-objects-locales-zh-hant.md`: `'@objectstack/platform-objects': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The PR body carries the same two lines. Correct: the diff adds translation data and one registration row per bundle; no published type, export shape, spec key or accepted value moves. `SetupAppTranslations` and `MetadataFormsTranslations` keep their `TranslationBundle` type and gain a key the platform locale table already declares (`PLATFORM_LOCALES`, #30001). The changeset body matches the precedent changesets in form and names the package number and the six locales that follow.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Face: `record-recognisers.mjs --paths` over the 36 paths says the paths decide no face (no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed path). The `Clause-②:` line is a plain `no`, so no face of the contract four is touched by the declaration either. The review is owed by the 3,000-line rule (AGENTS.md line 499: 7,271 changed lines, generated files included), which lands the PR the Tier H way. The tier on this record is the one the dispatch brief asked for; the seat reads the recogniser's answer above when it requests the human approval.
- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay); the body's attribution names `os-elon-musk`. The dev's `open_questions` is empty; `security_findings` withheld; two `out_of_scope_findings` are `zh-CN` quality notes, not changed here, and I agree they are out of this card's scope.
- The dev's seven deviations are each confirmed above (regex widening, pinned-set tests, cross-package pins, root script left for the last PR, stale-fill fix in `zh-Hant` only). Turbo concurrency and the assignee are process notes.
- Not changed, and should not be: `scripts/i18n-stale-fill-baseline.json`, `scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs`, root `package.json`, `packages/spec/**`.
- CI on the head at the time of writing: every gate-carrying job that has finished is `success` (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Build Core, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Live E2E UI, Test UI, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, the Lint and Type Check sub-lanes, PR-body guards, Dogfood Regression Gate). `Test Core (1/8)` and `(4/8)` were still `in_progress` at the last read; `(2/8)`, `(3/8)` and `(5/8)` to `(8/8)` are `success`. Nothing is red. The commit status is `pending` only because of those two shards. Skipped jobs are the UI, docs and opt-in lanes that do not run for this path set. The seat confirms the two shards green before asking for approval.

### ④ Design judgment

No `hits` file, so no schema, rule or narrowing to judge. The content was judged against the code it feeds: `withSourceFallback` (`source-hash.ts:581`) reads a hand table and a generated table per locale, and both `zh-Hant` tables are complete and digest-exact against the current `en`, so the first `en` edit under any leaf falls back rather than serving a stale string, which is the mechanism's purpose. The `cli` regex widening is the right fix for a test whose purpose is to judge every inline map on the shipped pages: the platform locale table ships a script-subtag tag, and a shape test that cannot see it judges nothing.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 平台内置对象（用户、组织、会话、API 密钥、OAuth、SSO、SCIM、通知、邮件、任务、导入、元数据、设置、汇率等全部 `sys_*`）、Studio 里各元数据类型的配置表单、「设置」「Studio」「账户」三个应用的导航、系统概览仪表盘与数据集、平台页面标题，以及用户 / 组织记录页上的内联文案，补上繁体中文（zh-Hant）。
- **为什么改：** 平台语言表要求每个界面带齐 11 种语言；这是第 3 期按包补齐的最后一个包（platform-objects）的第 1 种语言。用繁中的管理员和开发者打开平台不再大面积看到英文。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加翻译数据和注册行，不动逻辑、schema、接口；原有 4 种语言一字未改。新语言同样走「源文本哈希回退」，手写部分每条都记了源哈希。测试改动都是把 zh-Hant 加进各测试的语言列表（覆盖变宽，没有放宽断言），外加 cli 一个形状测试的语言码正则放宽到接受 `zh-Hant` 这种书写体子标签（否则它一个内联文案都认不出）。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `src/apps/translations/setup.translation.ts` 与 `src/metadata-translations/index.ts`（注册），`scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts`（`--locales` 加 zh-Hant），然后抽看 `zh-Hant.ts`（导航，约 140 条）和任一生成文件。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=platform-objects` 输出 in sync；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test` 全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 本 PR 改动 7271 行（含生成物），超过 3000 行，按规程需 GOVERNED_APPROVERS（os-zhuang / hotlong）任一位 APPROVE。契约复核已过：PASS 记录 6686780589，`Head-sha` `e8d9055ec7ca343cb5b308a8019843f5c138f7e7`。批准后由席位经合并队列落地，不需要你合并。
- **席位意见：** 同意落地。纯翻译数据加注册行，结构与已合入的 #30870 / #30931 同形；复核逐项核过键集、源哈希、繁体用字与两条跨包钉，无必须修复项。

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · 2026-11-06T14:16Z · #30512 (platform-objects PR 1 of 7, zh-Hant)

- **Shape:** 36 files, +7216 / -55. Generated bundles (`zh-Hant.objects.generated.ts`, `zh-Hant.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, source hashes), the hand bundle `zh-Hant.ts`, registration rows mirroring the existing three locales, one `'zh-Hant'` key added to each inline page label map and the dashboard `nullLabel`, and 24 test files whose pinned locale lists gained zh-Hant. - **Gates:** every check-run on this head has concluded: 48 distinct checks, the latest run of each 35 success, 13 skipped, 0 failure; `mergeable_state` clean. Locally (dev report 6686432570 on #30512): build 118/118, platform-objects 1636 tests, 64 derived families exit 0 with `--ran` 0 not measured, `pnpm lint` 0, the docs & code guards lane 56 × exit 0.
